tweets.author: Brian McTaggart
tweets.html: Hunter Brown on his lack of swing and miss today (6): "My chase is down and not getting as many whiffs. If you want to ask them and come back to me and see what their approach was, I would love to have that info, too. I mean, I can't tell you. You go from having a bunch of whiffs to one game not. Is it their approach? Is it their execution? I mean, that's the game. That's baseball. Unfortunately tonight, I got one big whiff against Devers and outside of that I don't think any were too important."

tweets.html: It’s looking unlikely for Nick Kurtz to return this season. His PRP injection on Aug. 4 went well, but he has to be in a brace for four weeks after that. Kotsay: “Four weeks of no mobility. You probably can do the timeline and think through the scenarios in front of us for Nick.”

tweets.author: Jeff Passan
tweets.html: The New York Yankees are calling up right-handed reliever Bradley Hanner, sources tell ESPN. Hanner, 27, has a 2.10 ERA with 61 strikeouts in 51.1 innings at Triple-A. A 21st-round pick in 2019, Hanner will make his major league debut when Aaron Boone calls his number.
